I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I said I'd noted her tip but only as unverified, and that nothing she can see confirms it.

- **What I checked:** gbrain, using only sources Ilse can see. I found nothing about a Linden rollout or Oriel Brevik.
- **Who owns the account:** a public January 2026 handoff note puts Marrow Fieldworks with the Central team. I told her the Central team or the account owner would be the ones to confirm the real contact.
- **What I did with it:** I'm not treating Oriel Brevik as the contact. gbrain had already saved her message automatically, labelled as hers and with her "unverified" wording. I added nothing to it.

I didn't read any Central channels, since Ilse isn't a member of them.
